import numpy as np, mujoco as mj, rcb_dtb as r
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from PIL import Image
class Controller:
 def __init__(self):
  self.s=r.Session();self.m=self.s.model;self.d=self.s.data;self.k=mj.MjData(self.m); self.pid=self.m.body('palmworld').id
  self.R0=self.d.xmat[self.pid].reshape(3,3).copy();self.q=r.INIT_Q.copy()
 def ik(self,p,R,q=None):
  q=self.q.copy() if q is None else q.copy();jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));jr=jp.copy()
  for _ in range(80):
   self.k.qpos[self.s._jq]=q;mj.mj_forward(self.m,self.k)
   e=np.r_[p-self.k.xpos[self.pid],Rot.from_matrix(R@self.k.xmat[self.pid].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(e)<1e-6:break
   mj.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,jp,jr,self.pid);J=np.vstack([jp[:,:7],jr[:,:7]])
   v=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e);v*=min(1,.12/(np.max(abs(v))+1e-9));q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7]+v,self.s.lower[:7],self.s.upper[:7])
  return q
 def move(self,p,R=None,hand=None,n=120):
  R=self.R0 if R is None else R
  p0=self.d.xpos[self.pid].copy();r0=Rot.from_matrix(self.d.xmat[self.pid].reshape(3,3));dr=Rot.from_matrix(R@r0.as_matrix().T).as_rotvec();h0=self.q[7:].copy()
  for t in range(n):
   a=(t+1)/n;a=a*a*(3-2*a)
   self.q=self.ik(p0+(p-p0)*a,Rot.from_rotvec(dr*a).as_matrix()@r0.as_matrix())
   if hand is not None:self.q[7:]=h0+(hand-h0)*a
   self.s.step(self.q)
 def hold(self,n=60):
  for _ in range(n):self.s.step(self.q)
 def snap(self,name):
  Image.fromarray(self.s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
  print(name,self.s.progress(),self.s.state()['object_pos'],flush=True)
 def contacts(self):
  for c in self.d.contact:
   b=[self.m.body(self.m.geom_bodyid[g]).name for g in c.geom]
   if 'object' in b:print(b,c.dist,c.pos)
